identification: Gents yellow gold ring with a large rectangular step-cut green stone (emerald cut, about 12x10mm, bright saturated colour typical of a synthetic emerald/spinel or glass) in a rubover bezel with rope-twist border, pierced and chased scroll shoulders. Mid-20th century signet/class-ring style. Catalogue: stamped 750 but acid tests as 15ct. Armitage estimate 800-1000; first bid step $400, so current bid about $380. Value is gold weight; the stone adds little.
